name: Goyal Associates Limited
about: Goyal Associates Limited, a non-banking financial service company, engages in the financing and investment activities in India. It provides micro enterprise, SME, vehicle, and agro based loans; and personal loans, as well as loans to micro financial institutions and NBFCs. The company is also involved in the share trading and other financial related activities of NBFCs. Goyal Associates Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
